title: Noor and the Hollow
author: Odile Kavanagh
blurb: Noor Ishikawa, a bone-carver who hears the dead, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. Then the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must reforge a broken covenant between realms, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
